teacher_input: student full input_ids and attention_mask; no teacher templating or re-encoding
math_system: Please reason step by step, and put your final answer within \boxed{}.
code_system_policy: Preserve the audited student default template; do not change sealed code-v2 prompts.
common_support: Read contiguous effective IDs from the pinned tokenizer audit, never min(head sizes).
eos_policy: Use student rollout EOS once; do not append, remove or replace EOS for teacher scoring.
loss_policy: Response target mask including generated EOS; logits at t-1 predict token t; padding and prompt targets excluded.
generation_policy: Mask output rows outside audited common support before sampling.
kl_policy: Independently FP32 log_softmax on audited common support, then reverse KL on response prediction positions.
evaluation_policy: All D0/student/teacher math comparisons use this version; historical different-prompt scores require a new baseline. No test-driven prompt selection.
status: CPU contract; GPU rollout, forward and quality acceptance pending
